settings.hero_body: A collection of color, shape and small expressive details. With all eight included, you can make a display that feels considered from the first piece to the last.
settings.detail_title: Eight designs, down to the details.
settings.detail_body: Look closely at the embroidered faces, colorful hoods and little brown paws. Every companion brings its own silhouette to the collection you have been picturing.
settings.final_body: Choose the complete eight and arrange a collection with your own point of view.
settings.moods_body: Different ears, hoods and colors give every companion a role in the full set.
settings.personality_title: Your arrangement is part of the design.
settings.personality_body: Try a sweep of color or a symmetrical lineup. Each plush stands apart visually while the brown paws bring the group together. Display stands are not included.
settings.hand_note: Eight companions. Every pictured design included.
